simple.meaning: כָּבֵד (kâbêd) is a Hebrew object word meaning “heavy ; figuratively in a good sense ( numerous ) or in a bad sense ( severe , difficult , stupid ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 12:10. The surrounding context includes family line, flock, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּבֵד (H3515) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: heavy ; figuratively in a good sense ( numerous ) or in a bad sense ( severe , difficult , stupid )
definitions.usage: (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.
definitions.full: H3515. kabed כָּבֵד adjective heavy ; — ׳כ Gen 41:31 + 34 t.; construct כְּבַד Exod 4:10 (twice in verse); כֶּבֶד Isa 1:4 ; plural כְּבֵדִים Exod 17:12 ; construct כִּבְדֵי Ezek 3:5-6 , — 1. a. heavy , a burden Psa 38:5 ; hands (weary of holding up) Exod 17:12 (E), hair of head 2Sam 14:26 , a corpulent old man 1Sam 4:18 ; עָוֺן כֶבֶד עַם Isa 1:4 a people heavy with ( the burden of ) iniquity; a cloud charged with rain Exod 19:16 (E); a rock of large size Isa 32:2 ; oppressive, grievous, burdensome , a yoke 1Kin 12:4 , 11 2Chr 10:4 , 11 ; a famine Gen 12:10 ; 41:31 ; 43:1 ; 47:4 , 13 (J); the vexation ( כַּעַס ) of a fool Prov 27:3 ; vehement, sore , of a mourning Gen 50:11 (J). b. massive, abundant, numerous , of a people עַם Num 20:20 (J) 1Kin 3:9 ; army חיל 2Kin 6:14 ; 18:14 = Isa 36:2 insect swarm Exod 8:20 (J). c. heavy, dull of speech and tongue Exod 4:10 (twice in verse) (JE); of the לֵב , hard 7:14 (J). d. hard, difficult , of a thing to be done Exod 18:18 (E) Num 11:14 (J); of a language to be understood Ezek 3:5-6 ,. 2 in the usage of J מְאֹד כָּבֵד is frequent: a. very oppressive, grievous , of hail Exod 9:18 , 24 ; murrain 9:8 ; lamentation Gen 50:10 . b. very numerous , cattle Exod 12:38 ; army, מַחֲנֶה Gen 50:9 ; locusts Exod 10:14 ; so חַיִל 1Kin 10:2 2Chr 9:1 . c. very rich , במקנה in cattle Gen 13:2 .
